newsitem.title: DUBAI: Bahrain jails three for arson attack.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain jails three for arson attack.

text.p: Bahrain's state security court has sentenced three nationals to jail terms for an arson attack linked to political unrest, Bahraini newspapers said on Sunday.
The newspapers said one Bahraini was sentenced to three years in prison and two others for two years each for an arson attack in February on an electricity sub-station.

The court, whose sentences cannot be appealed, has sentenced more than 150 people since the government ordered it in March to try hundreds of detainees held for street protests, sabotage and arson attacks since political unrest erupted in the Gulf Arab island in December 1994.
Members of Bahrain's majority Shi'ite Moslem community have been waging a violent campaign to demand political and economic reforms. More than 27 people have died in waves of violence.
Diplomats say the government has over the past few months contained the unrest in the Gulf's financial and banking centre.
